quotes.text: Let us sing unto him a new song: let us sing of his marvellous doings in the last days.
Let us sing unto him a new song: let us sing of bis marvellous doings in the last days.

Now, brothers and sisters, we must do our duty, whatever that duty might be. Peace may be denied for a season. Some of our liberties may be curtailed. We may [CR, 91] be inconvenienced. We may even be called on to suffer in one way or another. But God our Eternal Father will watch over this nation and all of the civilized world who look to Him. He has declared, “Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord” (Psalm 33:12). Our safety lies in repentance. Our strength comes of obedience to the commandments of God.
quotes.speaker: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.attr: Gordon B. Hinckley, in Conference Report, Oct. 2001, 90–91; or Ensign, Nov. 2001, 74
